subject: Pricing & model-mix follow-up — numbers requested
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tim Ellis <tim.ellis@asterion.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & model-mix follow-up — numbers requested

Hi Tim — great call this morning, appreciate the clear context on your use cases (autonomous orchestration logs + agent prompt layer). Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can build an accurate proposal: 

Recap
- Primary workload: real-time chat assistants that summarize telemetry and generate actionables for operators (avg prompt ~850 tokens, chat with ~220 tokens returned)
- Secondary: embeddings for semantic search (batch, ~512 tokens per item)
- Tertiary: a lightweight reranker for recommended fixes (~60 tokens per verification call)

Asks / numbers we need from you to lock pricing: 
1) Expected monthly request volume (API calls) per workload type for first 6 months and steady-state (ballpark is fine).
2) Target monthly budget range (USD) for inference — we heard a broad $/month range on the call but need confirmation.
3) Any strict latency SLOs for the chat path (p95 target) and whether embeddings can be async.

If you can send the above by EOD Wednesday that’ll let us run a few $/1M-token scenarios and propose a model mix (chat / embeddings / rerank) with per-model unit economics. 

I attached a quick template you can paste numbers into (redwood-draft-pricing.xlsx).

Next step: once we have volumes/budget we’ll return a short two-sheet pricing proposal (unit $/1M tokens + recommended model allocation + expected monthly spend).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-draft-pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Tim Ellis <tim.ellis@asterion.ai>

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model-mix follow-up — numbers requested

Thanks Vanessa — pasted answers below (high level for now; procurement looped). Happy to refine.

1) Volumes (month 1 -> steady-state):
- Chat assistant: 120k calls/month -> 600k calls/month (each call ~1,070 tokens total: request+response)
- Embeddings: 250k items/month (batch ingestion, avg 512 tokens per text)
- Reranker: 40k calls/month (50 tokens per call)

2) Target budget (monthly): $8k -> $32k (we’re evaluating pilot in months 1–3 then scaling)

3) Latency SLOs: Chat p95 target 400ms for interactive flows; embeddings async ok (24h ingestion window); reranker p95 <150ms.

Procurement: procurement@asterion.ai — they’ll take the official quote and PO process.

—Tim
Tim Ellis
Head of Product, Asterion Robotics
tim.ellis@asterion.ai

- Chat: 120k -> 600k calls/month (~1,070 tokens per call)

If you can also include expected monthly spend table and a suggested pilot-configuration (model choices + traffic split), that’d be ideal — Tim needs something to share with procurement by Thursday EOD.

Vanessa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing & model-mix follow-up — numbers requested

Quick proposal (3-option summary) — attachments: token-econ-scenarios.pdf (stapled sheet). I’ll paste the short bullets here so Vanessa can send to Asterion today.

Baseline assumptions used for calc:
- Chat avg tokens per call: 1,070 -> 1,070 tokens/call (request+response)
- Embeddings tokens per item: 512 tokens/item
- Reranker tokens per call: 50 tokens/call
- Pilot traffic month: Chat 120k calls, Embeddings 250k items, Reranker 40k calls

Option A — Cost-optimized
- Model choices: Chat: rdx-compact-1 (8-bit quantized), Embeddings: embed-lite, Reranker: rank-lite
- Estimated unit price: $420 / 1M tokens
- Pilot monthly spend estimate: ~ $6.8k (below target lower bound)
- Notes: meets latency targets with burst reserved capacity + caching; quality tradeoffs on nuanced operator instructions.

Option B — Balanced (recommended)
- Model choices: Chat: rdx-chat-2 (mixed-precision), Embeddings: embed-standard, Reranker: rank-standard
- Estimated unit price: $1,100 / 1M tokens
- Pilot monthly spend estimate: ~ $18.6k (within Tim’s mid-range)
- Notes: meets p95 targets; good quality/latency balance. Suggest 60% of chat load to rdx-chat-2, 30% to rdx-chat-2-quant (cheaper variant) during pilot for fallbacks.

Option C — Quality-first
- Model choices: Chat: rdx-chat-pro, Embeddings: embed-pro, Reranker: rank-pro
- Estimated unit price: $2,100 / 1M tokens
- Pilot monthly spend estimate: ~ $35k (exceeds target upper bound)
- Notes: best quality; only recommended if budget expands or for small subset of critical flows.

Per-model recommended pilot split (volume percent):
- Chat: rdx-chat-2 70%, rdx-chat-2-quant 30%
- Embeddings: embed-standard 100% (batch, no split)
- Reranker: rank-standard 100%

Action items for Vanessa to send to Asterion: 
- Option B as our recommended starter with the attached scenario PDF and a short note on upgrade paths (can scale to C or trim to A).
- Ask procurement whether the $18.6k pilot aligns with their $8k-$32k band (call out that Option A would be below their lower band).

I attached the scenario sheet (token-econ-scenarios.pdf) with tables and the per-model per-token math. Happy to hop on a quick call with Tim if they want to walkthrough.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
